name: della-sistema-pedidos
description: Sistema de gestão de pedidos de venda, orçamentos, clientes, produtos e representantes da Della

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
